title: Morphology label prediction from scalar intrinsic electrophysiology
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: Allen mouse Cell Types binary aspiny/spiny annotation, excluding sparsely spiny; 1356 training and 457 test cells, held-out donors; 11 intrinsic-electrophysiology scalar inputs, macro-F1. No traces, morphology image, transcriptome or genotype predictor.

existing_reference.name: Donor-CV-selected RF500 / ExtraTrees500
existing_reference.evidence: A: fixed donor validation and exact local result.
problems: Not a current domain-specific foundation model or a complete cell taxonomy.
Scalar summaries cannot support claims about raw electrophysiology understanding.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: TabPFN-3.5
candidates.information_match: Direct numerical classification fit; exact donor-shift performance and weight permissions remain to be checked.

candidates.name: TabICLv2
candidates.information_match: Direct feature match with train-only imputation and donor validation; no published frozen-slice score.

candidates.name: Regularized boosted-tree / kernel classifier panel
candidates.evidence: C: conventional proposal motivated by current comparative tabular benchmark, not a cell-specific published win.
candidates.information_match: Same 11 inputs and donor validation; likely feasible without extra biological modalities.

candidates.name: Allen morpho-electric taxonomy pipeline
candidates.evidence: B: primary source taxonomy, not a supervised classifier for this endpoint.
candidates.information_match: Richer morphology/physiology clustering changes both inputs and target; do not use its taxonomy scores.

recommended_next_comparator: Pinned TabICLv2 and locally licensed TabPFN-3.5 alongside a donor-selected boosted-tree/kernel panel, all on the same 11 scalar inputs.
switching_assessment: ADD modern tabular contenders, medium priority, Tier B. Retain tree reference; no evidence yet that any newer model wins donor-held-out binary morphology. Do not relabel transcriptomic or extracellular foundation models as direct replacements.
limitations: Donor grouping must be respected in validation.
Aspiny/spiny is a morphology label, not exhaustive molecular cell identity.
Published full taxonomy classification is not this binary endpoint.
Current TabPFN license and external pretraining are separate from general-code runtime budgets.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
